फल्गुन: Phalguna m.: Name of a month. A. Epic event: The Pāṇḍavas procee-ded from Hāstinapura to Vāraṇāvata on the eighth day of the month of Phalguna and under the constellation Rohiṇī (अष्टमे ऽहनि रोहिण्यां प्रयाताः फल्गुनस्य ते) 1. 133. 30. [See Bhagadaiva]
फल्गुनी: Phalgunī: See Pūrvā Phalgunī and Uttarā Phalgunī.
फलकीवन: Phalakīvana nt.: Name of a forest. Described as the best (उत्तम) 3. 81. 72; gods resort to it and practise austerities for many thousand years 3. 81. 72; (perhaps the river Dṛṣadvatī flows through it and the Sarvadevānāṃ tīrtham is also in that forest 3. 81. 73-74).
फल्गु: Phalgu1 f.: Name of a river. Described as a great river (महानदी) and having holy water (पुण्यजला) 3. 85. 9; flows near the mountain Gaya and along Gayā 3. 85. 6, 7. [See Phalgu2]

Phalgu2, Phalgutīrtha nt.: Name of a तीर्थ। Situated near Gayā 3. 82. 84; by visiting it one gets the fruit of an Aśvamedha and acquires great perfection (सिद्धिं च महतीं व्रजेत्) 3. 82. 86; mentioned in the Daivata-Ṛṣi-Vaṃśa 13. 151. 23, 2. [See Phalgu1]
